Polymarket Promo Code SBWIRE Get $25 Bonus for NFL, Politics & More (Oct. 23) PGA Tour LPGA College Amateur Golf Life Real Estate Equipment Apparel Newsletters SPORTS Polymarket Promo Code SBWIRE Get $25 Bonus for NFL, Politics & More
 Mark Strotman Oct. 23, 2026, 6:16 p.m. ET This week is loaded with trading opportunities, and new users can trade on all of it with the Polymarket promo code SBWIRE that delivers $25 in trading credits. The Rays and Brewers meet in Game 1 of the World Series Friday, followed by UFC 333 and college football on Saturday and a Sunday NFL slate that kicks off early in Paris. There are no shortages of choices.
 Credits work on any market you like. Super Bowl futures, conference and division winners, MVP races and single-game contracts are listed, along with soccer, the NHL, politics, world events and crypto.
 Polymarket is open to eligible U.S. users in 49 states and Washington, D.C. (Nevada excluded). Enter SBWIRE while you register. It can’t be added after your account is created.

 Explore how to live where you love to play Access community guides, golf real estate insights, trusted agent connections, and content built for passionate golfers. Using the Polymarket Promo Code for NFL, MLB & NCAAF
 Polymarket markets are yes or no questions priced in cents. If the Broncos trade at 48 cents to win, the market sees roughly a 48 percent chance. A correct share pays $1, a $0.52 profit per share. A wrong one pays nothing.
 Your $10 deposit plus the Polymarket promo code SBWIRE bonus gives you $35 in trading capital. That’s enough to take a position on Thursday night and still have room for the weekend. Prices move with the news. You can close a position before the market resolves if you want out early.
 Baseball and college football fit prediction markets well because the odds change constantly. A playoff game can swing on one inning. A college football matchup can flip on one quarter.
 Since you trade against other users, not a house, prices reflect what the crowd thinks right now. The Polymarket promo code SBWIRE credits can go toward any of it, so you aren’t tied to the NFL.
 How to Claim Polymarket Promo Code SBWIRE
 Tap a PLAY NOW link on this page to download Polymarket from the Apple App Store or Google Play.
 Create a new Polymarket US account. You’ll enter your name, address, phone number and Social Security number for identity verification.
 Add the Polymarket promo code SBWIRE during registration.
 Deposit at least $10 with Apple Pay, Google Pay, a debit card or another supported method.
 Make your first trade. The $25 posts as trading credits.
 Where the Polymarket Promo Code Works
 Polymarket’s U.S. arm runs through QCEX, a CFTC-registered exchange. Trades settle in USDC on the Polygon blockchain.
 The offer covers 49 states and D.C., with Nevada excluded. Users need to be 18 or older, compared with 21 at most licensed sportsbooks. Prediction markets are still a developing regulatory category, so check current platform rules before you fund an account.
 Polymarket Promo Code SBWIRE FAQs
 What is the Polymarket promo code?
 The Polymarket promo code is SBWIRE . New users who enter it at registration and deposit $10 receive a $25 trading bonus after their first completed trade.
 Can I use the bonus on college football and baseball?
 Yes. The $25 arrives as trading credits that can go toward any active event contract, including NFL, MLB playoff and college football markets, plus soccer, politics and crypto.
 Is a promo code the same as an invite code?
 Yes. Polymarket and its partners use promo code, invite code and referral code for the same sign-up field. Enter SBWIRE there during registration to qualify.
 Can I add the code after I sign up?
 No. The code only works at registration. If your account already exists, SBWIRE won’t apply, so enter it before you finish setting up your profile.
